rules: Never reconstruct a trademark from screenshots
Read and record the current brand/CI guideline before publication
Store untouched source separately from generated wallee presentation assets
Record usage restrictions and authorization requirements

ep2.note: Official vector master supplied directly for this repository; preserve unchanged.

wallee.note: Official RGB package supplied directly; SVG wordmark and high-resolution signet available.

garmin-pay.rule: Official Garmin Pay assets must be requested from Garmin. Do not scrape/reconstruct.

samsung-wallet.rule: Use approved Wallet logo lock-up and toolkit variant appropriate to context.

postfinance.rule: Corporate PostFinance, PostFinance Card and PostFinance Pay are distinct marks.

alipay-plus.rule: Use only under applicable authorization/license and product-specific display guideline.

click-to-pay.rule: Use EMVCo Click to Pay mark and applicable mark usage guidance.

twint.rule: Merchant product logo is distributed through TWINT Business Portal; use received product logo unchanged and clearly visible.

swatchpay.rule: First-party site confirms current SwatchPAY! mark; obtain original distributable artwork rather than extracting a rendered page image.
